statements.text: House Aumery holds the eastern march from its seat at Greystone
The house colours are green and gold
Each midwinter the lords of the march gather in the great hall for the tourney
Anselm Aumery — is the present lord of — House Aumery
His hall is known for its generosity
Edric is not in fact Anselm's blood
The true heir, Cressida, was the child of Anselm's elder brother
Under the chapel of Greystone runs a passage that leads to the old postern
only the castellan and the lord know where the iron key is hidden behind the altar
she was sent north as a babe to be raised by a miller's family under another name
